: T h i s w r i t p e t i t i o n h a s b e e n p r e f e r r e d a g a i n s t t h e o r d e r d a t e d  31st October, 2013 passed by the Deputy Commissioner, Ranchi in connection with Food Safety  and Standards Case No.04 of 201213 by which learned Deputy Commissioner has  imposed penalty of Rs.5.00 lacs under Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Food Safety  and Standards Case No.04 of 201213
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: I t i s s u b m i t t e d t h a t t h e p e t i t i o n e r h a s n o t b e e n g i v e n  o p p o r t u n i t y t o c o n t e s t t h e p r o c e e d i n g .
N o n o t i c e w a s e v e r s e r v e d  on the petitioner.
It is indicated in the order sheet that in spite of notice issued, the accused did  not appear and he refused to accept the notice.
As a matter of fact, the accused never refused  to receive any notice issued in connection with this case.
Principle of natural justice demands  that the petitioner may be given opportunity to place his defence before the concerned court.
Counsel for the State is absent.
It is apparent from the impugned order itself that the same has been passed ex parte.

It is  pointed out that Food Safety Appellate Tribunal has not yet been notified in the State  o f J h a r k h a n d a n d , t h e r e f o r e , t h e p e t i t i o n e r h a s l e f t n o o p t i o n b u t t o  file the present writ petition before this Court.
Since Food Safety Appellate Tribunal has not yet been notified, the petitioner shall not  be debarred from raising his grievance before this Court in writ jurisdiction.

In the circumstances, the impugned order dated 31st October, 2013 passed by the  court of learned Deputy Commissioner, Ranchi in Food Safety and Standards Case No.4 of  201213 is hereby set aside, giving liberty to the petitioner to appear before the
